capabilityGaps.summary: Production progressive JPEG events, bounded incremental preparation, shared-transport ownership, final full-body fallback and UIKit/SwiftUI promotion are implemented locally. Clean preregistered W4 comparative runs, physical-device presentation/resource tails and release qualification remain pending.

Fovea has a decoder-neutral animation player and ImageCraft implementationVersion 2 has a public owned RGBA8 non-interlaced APNG route up to 1024 with aligned ImageIO fallback. Current source-bound captures prove 24/24 Python exact, 21/21 Apple exact where aligned, separate-default 3/3, all seven retained fixtures ownedAPNG, reverse access exact, cancellation fenced and explicit retained/peak accounting. IMG_ANIM_PT_051 prevents repeated random-access work inside frame windows; IMG_ANIM_PT_052 binds single-frame/window fallback pixels. ImageCraft passes 126 ImageIO plus 16 Core tests and warnings-as-errors Release. The current owned APNG hot path is source-bound at ImageCraft working tree f0a2c8b5273b27a76fe78fc41f55cab8a5512d17: on the retained PIA-6 physical-Mac directional endpoint, 200 iterations measure prepare at 1.0033x the direct ImageIO lower bound, selected-frame at 0.8504x direct retained ImageIO and sequential-all-frames at 0.3911x, with exact pixels, reverse random access and cancellation fencing unchanged. This supersedes the earlier-tree Mac latency deficit but remains formalClaimEligible=false. The isolated Fovea adapter is requalified by the v7 manifest-final overlay against the current post-H009/H006 plus compact-Akashic integrated source set. Akashic Git-free verified source identity is 5d31cc1800940332f4fc0928869747721885315006597148b6564b99feb07c45; ImageCraft working tree remains f0a2c8b5273b27a76fe78fc41f55cab8a5512d17. Exact Git working-tree identities for all three repositories are deliberately kept in the external v7 qualification artifact rather than copied into Fovea tracked continuity, avoiding a self-referential Fovea tree hash. W5_ADAPTER_PT_001-008 pass, strict format and warnings-as-errors qualification pass, full sources and selected animation implementation files are unchanged during qualification, production Package.swift/ImageCraft pin are unchanged and formalClaimEligible remains false; publication, production pinning and physical iOS deadline/memory/energy/thermal/reclamation gates remain open. Platform presenters now use deduplicated structural visibility rather than window attachment alone: hidden and alpha-zero views pause, AppKit ancestor hide/unhide is observed, and screen-intersection caching remains explicitly deferred to avoid sticky pause after ancestor scrolling. UIKit presentation now has an opt-in external-tick driver wired to CADisplayLink targetTimestamp: first-frame publication remains immediate, slow callbacks retain only the newest pending target, nonmonotonic timestamps are rejected, and structural invisibility pauses the display link. The production UIKit target builds for iOS 15. AppKit now uses NSView-bound CADisplayLink targetTimestamp external ticks on macOS 14+ while preserving the macOS 12-13 absolute-deadline fallback and macOS 12 deployment floor; detached modern views defer driver startup until first effective visibility so immediate first-frame semantics are preserved. W5_PT_142-143 bind timestamp conversion, external scheduling, deadline-loop suppression, visibility pause/resume and cancellation. AppKit target-buffer counters are package-scoped to FoveaAnimationMacLab, and package-only scheduler/refresh-observer seams now permit a physical-Mac internal control without widening ordinary public API. Physical-iOS timing/memory/energy/thermal evidence remains mandatory. Core eligibility notifications also stop the display link for application inactivity, explicit pause, critical pressure, cancellation and terminal playback; W5_PT_130-131 bind lifecycle suppression and the strictly monotonic constant-space newest-only buffer. A no-deadline first-frame decision is modeled as dormant rather than terminal: it stops display-link work but remains eligible to repopulate after critical pressure returns to normal. W5_PT_132 binds this distinction across external scheduling and the existing runtime/system recovery tests remain green. Frame-window residency is now actual-byte informed rather than frame-count-only after the first observed frame: W5_PT_133 learns the maximum DecodedImage.estimatedByteCost and caps later windows by the shared animation-memory capacity; W5_PT_134 rejects out-of-target or nonresident single-frame provider output before publication; W5_PT_135 proves a tight cache retains the current frame and shrinks later prefetch. The first uncached batch deliberately remains frame-count bounded because targetPixels x 4 is not a universal byte-layout contract. Warning pressure now fences pre-warning in-flight normal-size windows before they can repopulate shared frame memory; W5_PT_136 proves publication revocation followed by a warning-size retry. Fovea intentionally does not copy FLAnimatedImage/YYImage per-player destructive warning trim because frames are shared across independent view clocks; a future trim must union active retention sets at runtime. W5_PT_137 adds saturating newest-only target-buffer counters for accepted, consumed, superseded, nonmonotonic-rejected and lifecycle-cleared presentation targets, separating display-refresh coalescing from timeline dropped-frame accounting. A concrete ImageCraftAnimationPlaybackPreparer candidate now passes W5_ADAPTER_PT_001 in an isolated copied-source Swift package overlay against current ImageCraft tree 5c07f313cf57495b6ffc7f578be8acbdd3e64c13: the real authorized FoveaSystemPipeline fetches a retained separate-default APNG, maps request geometry/color and explicit timing policy into the public ImageCraft animation API, publishes a first frame whose normalized sRGB premultiplied RGBA digest matches direct ImageCraft, then cancels with zero registered drivers. The production ImageCraft pin remains 736d0fb75e9e128642ce418ad984ce5151b1f324 and the candidate adapter remains a noncompiled qualification fixture. The overlay also exposed a pin-upgrade compile blocker in the previously exhaustive ImageCraftError switch; Fovea now fails newly introduced dependency cases closed through unexpectedImageCraftFailure while preserving all old-pin explicit reason mappings. W5_ADAPTER_PT_002 extends the same isolated adapter evidence through normal playback: a deterministic stepping clock drives the retained separate-default APNG through visible frames 0→1→2, all three normalized frame digests match direct ImageCraft, the source declares one play, and cancellation again leaves zero registered drivers. W5_ADAPTER_PT_003 reuses the same adapter on a retained 64-byte two-frame GIF with zero source delays: playOnce visible order is 0→1, both normalized pixels match direct ImageCraft, and the caller-versioned 10 ms zero-duration replacement is observed as 10/20 ms stepping-clock deadlines before zero-driver cleanup. W5_ADAPTER_PT_004 exercises the concrete adapter failure path after a valid ImageCraft GIF prepare: an invalid zero-duration replacement is rejected as invalidZeroDurationReplacement before handle registration, and the runtime remains at zero drivers. UIKit presentation-target counters are now observable without widening the ordinary API: FoveaImageView exposes a BenchmarkDiagnostics SPI snapshot containing accepted, consumed, superseded, nonmonotonic-rejected and lifecycle-cleared target counts plus pending/last-target/display-link-paused/effective-visibility state, so future physical runs can distinguish display-refresh coalescing from timeline dropped frames. UIKit animation lifecycle observation now preserves the existing ordinary public API budget: isHidden/alpha/didMoveToSuperview/layoutSubviews overrides are SPI implementation details, while a focused iOS15 symbol-graph gate proves the default FoveaUIKit surface remains 12/12 and a non-SPI consumer still accesses the inherited UIView members. BenchmarkDiagnostics animation presentation symbols appear only when SPI symbols are explicitly requested. ComparativeLabCore now supplies a common source-frame presentation oracle and tamper-resistant raw trace artifact for cross-player timing evidence; no ranking is activated until production adapters and stable-device runs exist. W5 common-oracle coverage now includes exact-pin Kingfisher, SDWebImage, PINRemoteImage, FLAnimatedImage 1.0.17 and AnimatedImage 0.2.4 adapters plus the Fovea player-only synthetic path. FLAnimatedImage has historical warm-state 61/60 evidence through a public Objective-C displayLayer shim, but current fresh isolated Simulator launches repeatedly stall at count 0 or 1 with zero progression; public cache-prewarm and visibility re-trigger experiments failed and were reverted, so FL is explicitly not comparable in the current fresh protocol. AnimatedImage 0.2.4 is explicitly not comparable on variable delay because its max-integrity prepared state uses one effective delay, but it passes the separate 50 ms uniform targetTimestamp mechanism fixture. All simulator values remain provisional and non-ranking. Gifu now also passes primary variable-delay and uniform structural loops through its public GIFAnimatable composition surface; its Swift 6 manifest raises only the comparator target to iOS16 while Fovea remains iOS15. YYImage 1.0.4 exact-source analysis exposed safe APNG semantic replay anchors. The current unpublished ImageCraft candidate implements the narrower persistent rule: full-background control reaches zero retained checkpoints with maximum resolved replay 1, while full-source+previous remains checkpoint bounded; IMG_ANIM_PT_053-056 and a unique contiguous animation-test-ID gate bind the behavior. APNGKit, SDWebImage and PINRemoteImage encoded-native plus the Fovea player-only path all complete the common 60-frame APNG structural oracle at 61 observations/60 transitions. A physical-Mac fixed-six/no-retry Release mechanism capture passes after W5_PT_144 fixed the future-targetTimestamp lifecycle clock regression: hidden target/provider counts remain flat, resume advances both, and cancellation leaves zero registered drivers. W5_PT_145-148 add a package-only automatic-deadline control, source-frame commit hook, observer-only common display link and exact playback-start clock anchor. The final fixed-six-pair/no-retry Release A/B samples both schedulers on the same NSView.displayLink.timestamp coordinate: every pair has no-worse external start-anchored p95 timing error and no-worse skipped source frames; median anchored p95 is 14.102375 ms versus 75.461355 ms and total skips are 0 versus 82. All retained runs observe a 16.666625 ms median display-link interval although maximumFramesPerSecond reports 120, so max-FPS-derived missed/early counts are supplemental only. This is one-host committed-frame refresh evidence, not hardware scanout or energy/thermal evidence, and formalClaimEligible remains false. The current latest-source local-edited integrated root suite is 830/830; H004 rendered-cache, H005 detach/reattach, H009 body-credit and H046 permit-lifetime regressions are included. This is current-tree local integration evidence, not release evidence. The only physical iPhone visible to Xcode is offline, so no stable iOS ranking or global Pareto claim is permitted.
Resumable transfer and interruption recovery are not implemented as a complete production capability.
The ImageIO animation backend now covers GIF/APNG and pre-split JPEG sequences. Animated WebP/HEIF/AVIF, HDR animated output, broad hostile corpora and cross-backend conformance remain incomplete.

The sole current ImageCodec v1 kit passes six obligations against the ImageIO reference fixture in an independent SwiftPM consumer. Real independent backends, hostile corpus, fuzz/sanitizer and protected composition evidence remain pending.
The independently developed codec has no Fovea adapter, corpus result, differential evidence, performance evidence, canary or default-selection certificate yet.

completedEvidence.summary: Five isolated comparator adapters and apps build for macOS/iOS Simulator under the selected Xcode 27 beta toolchain.
W1-W3 schema 3 Simulator calibration exists for Fovea and four external libraries; Simulator evidence is provisional and cannot support release performance claims.

Schema 2 and 3 artifacts remain historical and component-source-identity-unbound. Cache Lab V4 uses schema 4, twenty clean process blocks and passes all thirteen applicable dominance comparisons. Edited/dirty source still prevents a trusted release certificate.

The public exact-revision Fovea root suite passes 478/478. A temporary Akashic v2 edit also passes the four dual-schema manifest/fault tests, then automatically returns to the public checkout. Local success is not release or physical-device evidence.
The accepted W1-W15 names and purposes were restored from digest-bound user-provided prior discussion material; the registry is gap-free and Adaptive Representation is preserved as adjunct X1.
Repository-backed project memory, source manifest, discussion ledger, mandatory context rendering, local verify and CI continuity gates are active.

A 25-run schema 3 Simulator aggregate covers Fovea plus four locked external loaders across W1, W2 cold/warm-disk/warm-memory, and W3. Fovea hard-check failures are zero; eight external W3 semantic contract failures remain explicit. Simulator evidence is not release evidence.

Clean public-main commit 5a836c43566a completed all 30 W1-W3 structural specifications for the six A-tier headless comparators. Fovea and Apple Native have zero hard failures; eight external W3 semantic failures remain explicit. Three W3 repetitions per comparator reproduce the same 0/0/3/1/3/1 failure counts. Host quiescence was bypassed only in a separate diagnostic artifact, so no latency, throughput, resource or release ranking is permitted.

The final V2 tree-bound schema 4 campaign collected twenty clean process blocks and passed 12/13 applicable comparisons. Memory hot-scan throughput versus LRUCache had median ratio about 1.268x but 95% lower bound about 1.149x, so V2 did not pass the complete dominance portfolio. V2 was archived after a timing-boundary defect was identified.

All seven accepted A-tier Apple-platform comparators are represented in the unified Xcode project. Six headless implementations completed clean-source W1-W3 and W7 structural diagnostics. Apple AsyncImage and FoveaResponsiveImage completed the independent 30-run paired SwiftUI W1/W2/W10 structural matrix with zero hard failures. Quiet-host performance and physical evidence remain pending. AlamofireImage remains B-tier.

W7 exposed cancellation-cohort poisoning, cancellation result misclassification and replacement warmup amplification. Admission-aware replacement cohorts, cancellation-first result normalization, dynamic fetch handoff leases and synchronous warmup launch claims pass the retained production tests. V7 shared-origin interpretation is superseded by the preparation-barrier counterexample; V8 clean calibration remains pending.

W7 V6 observed nine newer origin starts although the internal scheduler admitted the background probe after at most eight newer grants. V7 separates internal grant fairness from downstream black-box start ordering and derives the latter bound as fifteen for the fixed eight-slot client budget.

The clean V7 matrix remains historical structural evidence, but its single-flight origin counts are not interpretable because 512 makeLoad calls were awaited serially while native work started immediately; a fixed delay did not guarantee full burst enrollment. Nuke priority-bypass evidence belongs to the unchanged priority subtrace and remains open.

A package-internal versioned codec descriptor, finite capability algebra, conservative resource estimate, progressive generation/frame timing values, backend-specific identity and conservative ImageIO adapter are implemented and tested; Stable public ImageDecoding remains unchanged.

Swift conformance tests exhaust 2,304 finite capability requests; the independent Python model checks 2,304 capability cases, 262,144 generation triples, 49 resource joins and 25 timing boundaries with zero errors.
ADR-0011, a primary-source research dossier and a parallel Fovea/codec roadmap define adopted, reserved and speculative mechanisms plus conformance, corpus, rollout and rollback gates.

The initial public codec algebra was rejected by the API budget and reduced to package access. ImageCraftCore and ImageCraftImageIO returned exactly to their existing public budgets; the total budget is now a zero-slack current-tree ceiling documented by the 2026-07 public API review.

The current repository action plan records exact public component identities, qualified codec/store boundaries, cross-repository gates, scoped Pareto comparison rules and future cross-platform direction.

On 2026-07-28 the clean ImageCraft repository passed scripts/verify-release-readiness.sh: 55 ImageCraftImageIO tests and 8 ImageCraftCore tests had zero failures, followed by Release build, external consumer, macOS/iOS platform matrix, libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0/libpng 1.6.58 independent oracles and retained-corpus reproducibility. Remote, tag, protected CI and physical-device evidence remain pending.

The accepted P0-P9 route skeleton is represented by a machine-readable roadmap manifest, included in mandatory task context, and protected by project-memory validation against silent deletion, renumbering and omission of unfinished work.

The retained decode-resource composition model passes four cases: two demonstrate max(generic, backend) under-reporting when coverage is disjoint or partially overlapping, two show max is exact only under stronger premises, and three demonstrate naive summation over-reporting. The model is now part of scripts/verify.sh; real backend lifecycle and device evidence remain open.

The clean ImageCraft repository at 05ab068c851d32a028f8556b2085a3266f0ee78c has no Git remote, no tags and no .github workflows. This precisely identifies why local release-readiness is insufficient for a pinned Fovea dependency and preserves remote ownership, release channel and protected CI as explicit blockers.

A machine-checked seven-phase ImageIO decode lifetime ledger records thirteen resources and five unresolved gaps. It proves the current scalar admission rule lacks declared coverage for prepared-state accumulation, opaque framework scratch, aliasing, final-output ownership transfer and operation-boundary reclaim tails; measurement and held-out backend evidence remain pending.

ADR-0014 is Accepted with SHA-256 BlobDigest, opaque CachePartitionID, partition-scoped physical deduplication, one active writer per StoreGeneration, a new generation for first extraction, and AKASHIC-CT-001 through AKASHIC-CT-030.

AkashicCore, AkashicMemory and AkashicDisk are the current public mechanism boundary. Fovea consumes the exact public revision through typed adapters; no embedded or alternate historical implementation is retained.

ImageCraft b17a8b9060f75d8ad75eab7accf48cffd5637171 replaces the JPEG entropy-region byte loop with Darwin memchr while preserving marker, byte-stuffing, restart-marker and metadata semantics. The clean package passes 64 component tests, Release, consumer/platform, retained-corpus and independent-oracle gates. A 588-sample interleaved A/B experiment across six JPEG paths records five 7/7 wins and one 6/7 win, with paired process-median reductions of about 8.9% to 16.9%. This is local macOS/ImageIO evidence, not a cross-device or non-ImageIO claim.

The mandatory Apple baselines remain distinct. Apple URLSession + automatic URLCache + ImageIO passed all five current W1-W3 structural specifications, while the paired AsyncImage surface passes local verification. The dedicated iOS 26.4.1 device completed first boot, verified live build 23E254a and installed all six headless apps. Host quiescence still blocks performance ranking.

The exact iOS 26.4.1 build 23E254a dedicated device is operational, has all six headless apps installed and completed the clean-source 30-spec structural diagnostic. One launch-blocking nsurlsessiond stall was recovered by restarting only the target device tree. A later callservicesd U state did not block container lookup or SpringBoard, proving that noncritical descendants cannot be treated as automatic device failure. Health schema 3 blocks global CoreSimulator services, target launchd_sim and SpringBoard/backboardd/runningboardd/lsd while recording other anomalies. No performance result is claimed.

Apple AsyncImage and Fovea SwiftUI apps are normalized symmetrically with ditto --noextattr --norsrc, recursive xattr clearing, post-resource ad-hoc signing and deep strict verification. Original DerivedData apps fail strict resource verification; both staged apps pass. Installation and runtime claims remain blocked by CoreSimulator health.

Clean commit 2decb76b completed five balanced-order paired blocks for Apple AsyncImage and FoveaResponsiveImage across W1 scroll, W2 hero and W10 identity churn: 30 runs, complete shared nonces and ordering, zero hard failures. Both surfaces pass no-crash, stale-success-zero, visible-success, terminal-phase and workload-specific completion checks. W1 and W10 request-count differences are descriptive only because host quiescence was bypassed for this structural diagnostic; hitch, latency, resource and superiority claims remain prohibited.

A clean-copy run exposed that timer-only tombstone cleanup could be delayed beyond its semantic lease. SharedTaskRegistry now records an absolute monotonic expiry and lazily expires on subscribe; the focused test passed 30/30 replays, all 14 SharedTaskTests passed, and the 705-state/8,346-transition model killed 6/6 mutants.

Fovea resolves ImageCraft 736d0fb75e9e128642ce418ad984ce5151b1f324 (an exact public commit after 0.1.0-alpha.5) and Akashic 2715f23d50b5a17b7328be41608eaf1b1c99b0d6 (0.1.0-alpha.5) as its only production component pins. Existing composition evidence applies to those pinned static/progressive and persistence surfaces; the local unpublished ImageCraft animation candidate is not consumed by Fovea.

V3 precomputed memory corpora but declared twenty hot-scan rounds while executing one. Its final full campaign also left hot throughput, hot p99 and disk p99 below the complete dominance rule. V3 artifacts remain historical research evidence only.

V4 implements twenty fresh-cache rounds and selects eight shards after sixteen shards retained 619/640 hot probes and thirty-two shards retained 21/32. The twenty-block full campaign passes all thirteen applicable endpoint comparisons with zero correctness, inferior, inconclusive or dominance failures.

The 81-file Git-free Akashic candidate 91608c55745b333bf28b923bf0bf64744541b5e81344f061a251adea483bdb92 passes complete local release-readiness mechanics and an independent Fovea source-copy integration with 478/478 tests. This is content-addressed local candidate evidence, not a public revision or trusted CI certificate.

PersistentStoreProvider conformance v1 runs in an independently generated SwiftPM consumer against the public FoveaAdvanced product. Five obligations cover stable provider identity, first fetch/decode/publish, network-free same-root reopen, persisted namespace revocation, and bounded open parameters. The source-bound report records exact ImageCraft/provider/Fovea/toolchain identities and explicitly remains non-release-qualified; crash consistency and cross-process writer exclusion are not claimed.

ImageCodec conformance v1 runs in an independently generated SwiftPM consumer against an external ImageIO fixture. Six source-bound obligations cover stable current descriptors, the complete 2304-request finite capability domain, advertised-format probe/decode, deterministic positive resource estimates with conservative host composition, and hard-limit failure closure. The report binds exact ImageCraft contract revision, backend source, factory, harness, Fovea kit tree and toolchain; hostile corpus, fuzz, sanitizer, physical-device and Fovea composition qualification remain separate.

The schema-4 Fovea candidate report consumes external source identity v2 documents without executing candidate-owned identity tools. Fovea independently binds component domain, complete coverage, exact exclusions, every file SHA-256 and executable bit, then materializes snapshots from freshly validated bytes. Only trusted public exact pins are resolved before isolation; candidate manifests first execute inside FOVEA-COMPONENT-CANDIDATE-SANDBOX-V1. Seatbelt denies network, original host-source reads and file writes except dedicated build state and narrowly enumerated Swift/Fovea test temporary roots. Seven runtime probes verify the effective boundary, the immutable Fovea source digest is identical before and after, Akashic 5887e2facb07 (84 files) and ImageCraft 045aa7013b19 (94 files) retain their identities after 478/478 tests, and six source-identity attacks still fail before build. The report self-binds the verifier, identity negative gate, identity specification, sandbox policy module, runtime profile and probe report. It explicitly records nativeBuildSystemDeprecated=true, defaultSwiftBuildSandboxQualification=false, candidateCanReadIsolatedFoveaSource=true, mutualConfidentialityClaim=false, publicRevisionClaim=false and trustedCIClaim=false; those report fields remain intentionally local-evidence scoped. Separately, the identical component bytes are now public as Akashic 2715f23d50b5 / 0.1.0-alpha.5 and ImageCraft e147b349d4ff / 0.1.0-alpha.4, both component Verify workflows are green, and Fovea public-pin tests pass 478/478.

V8 closes a /w7/shared response-delivery gate before constructing all 512 shared loads, while allowing native request creation and enrollment, then releases it before the cancellation delay. Four tree-bound dirty-source runs on iOS 27.0 build 24A5355p each recorded eight actual waiters, exactly sixteen shared origins and zero hard failures. Clean six-comparator calibration remains pending.

Cancellation handoff now continues an observed transport only when Content-Length makes the remaining bytes known and the remainder is no larger than min(target RGBA surface bytes, transport memory threshold). Each retry response resets its byte counter, non-identity content encodings and unknown-length observed transfers fail closed, and transports without progress observation retain the prior compatibility behavior. ComparativeLab separates post-cancellation bytes for completed and abandoned requests. The 495-test root suite and FoveaComparatorBench generic iOS Simulator build pass. Dirty-source W7 cancellation calibration, stable-device resource tails and release claims remain pending.

Ordinary-image W2 now separates adapter return, full pixel materialization and display-ready latency. Seven-image exact-pixel experiments support per-artifact derived formats and reject a global format or unconditional first-hit persistence. A 42-process nearest-integer aspect-fit A/B was rejected: direct decode median regressed 1.4 percent, cached-image materialization regressed 2.1 percent, and target-level direction was unstable. ImageCraft implementation version 4 remains authoritative; no performance or default-cache claim is permitted from dirty local evidence.

Fovea has a package-internal, default-off derived-raster path between rendered memory and authoritative original-encoded reuse. It creates only after reusable warm-disk original decode, never on network first display. The Akashic-backed derived store owns alias-aware global physical-byte accounting above the blob layer: shared physical containers are charged once; eviction removes all aliases before the victim blob; successful hits receive an in-memory second chance without a Fovea alias-manifest write; open reconciles missing targets and crash leftovers; normal post-blob publication failures attempt eager orphan cleanup. A separate durable fixed-window logical write gate now reserves candidate-container plus exact projected full Fovea alias-manifest bytes before blob staging, survives reopen, treats later uncertain failure conservatively as charged, and cannot be refreshed by a caller artifact timestamp or backward clock movement. The strict DerivedRaster suite includes PT040-PT045 for capacity, alias deduplication, recency, durable logical-write accounting, reopen/clock rollback and pipeline diagnostics. Public/default composition remains off; clean W2/W11, physical write-amplification calibration, fixed-window burst qualification, large-store reopen cost, device energy/thermal/reclaim-tail evidence and policy comparison remain pending.

ImageRequest now computes namespace and fetch-base SHA-256 identities once during validated construction and preserves them through retarget and reprioritize. Three 500-iteration Release blocks reduced warm-memory image(for:) from roughly 48-51 microseconds to 17-19 microseconds after the earlier namespace cache, and fixed-identity authorization from about 31.8 microseconds to 0.04-0.08 microseconds. Five diagnostic W2 simulator blocks show adapter median about 0.244 ms versus the prior 0.261 ms, while Apple display-ready remains materially faster. This is local directional evidence, not a release ranking.

A same-source multi-target event-stream test exposed one transport owner completing while a non-owner subscriber waited forever on a progressive finalization that never observed transport progress. Response completion now closes only an unobserved empty finalization and falls back to the ordinary full-body probe/decode path; the owner still validates and reuses prepared state. Adapter integration completes both targets with one transport, and progressive, decode-sharing and full root suites pass.

ImageCraft local unpublished animation candidate source identity 7d0a1d3cc1b7e64eef11372582dbd67ff6d26bb0186d75dfca0c3528c454f37f (265 files) adds a separate public ImageAnimationDecoding contract and ImageIO backend for GIF, APNG and pre-split complete JPEG sequences. IMG_ANIM_PT_001-026 are continuous: 18 decoder tests plus one actual-row-stride budget test and seven Core invariant tests cover exact rational timing, loop, frame rect/disposal/blend, on-demand frame/window decode, cancellation, strict Codable, format allowlists, APNG CRC/type/order/default-image semantics, GIF structural and interactive/text rejection, cumulative JPEG-sequence metadata, and logical-plus-actual decoded-byte gates. The 101-test root suite, warnings-as-errors Release build, public API/integration/source-identity gates, clean-copy replay, external macOS/iOS Simulator/iOS device consumer, repository platform matrix, independent oracles and retained/progressive corpus reproducibility pass. Relative to 0.1.0-alpha.5 the public API delta is 105 added, 0 removed and 0 changed. Existing codec-only performance studies remain dirty local directional evidence only. Fovea has the player/runtime and live MJPEG system path but still pins ImageCraft 736d0fb75e9e128642ce418ad984ce5151b1f324; GIF/APNG loading requires a published fixed animation revision and freshness/authorization integration.

FoveaHTTP strict multipart/x-mixed-replace framing is connected to URLSession through a progress-only transport capability with per-chunk hard-limit checks, incremental SHA-256, one-chunk delegate backpressure and no complete live-body staging. Complete JPEG parts reuse ordinary DecodeStage limits, target geometry, color policy, working-set permits, authorization and namespace generation. Latest-only playback, shared fetch admission, runtime lifecycle/critical-pressure control, namespace cancellation, Reduce Motion, diagnostics and UIKit/AppKit/SwiftUI presentation are covered within W5_PT_001-124. Generation floors reject stale live registration after revocation. The 660-test root suite, warnings-as-errors Release, generic iOS Simulator/device builds, CacheLab, loopback and both conformance kits pass on the current local source.

Fovea implements package-internal decoder-neutral animated playback with exact monotonic timeline/loop cursor, dropped-frame accounting, overlapping pause reasons, seek/cancellation, actual-byte SIEVE frame memory, bounded wrap-aware windows, independent clocks, absolute deadlines, lifecycle control and generation-fenced publication. The authorized encoded seam binds cache/network bytes to ContentID, exact request execution, selected representation and namespace generation, revalidates after decoder preparation, and cancels providers on every failed ownership transfer. Prepared assets additionally bind ImageRequest.renderAliasIdentity, covering target pixels, content mode, geometry policy, color policy and execution identity, so a provider prepared for one render request cannot be relabeled by another. Persistent generation floors reject stale static/live registration. W5_PT_001-124, 660 root tests, warnings-as-errors Release, generic iOS Simulator/device builds, current ComparativeLab, CacheLab, loopback and both conformance kits pass. Fovea still pins ImageCraft 736d0fb75e9e128642ce418ad984ce5151b1f324; a real GIF/APNG preparer remains unwired and non-public/default.

The official system composition can create a namespace-bound live MJPEG handle that preserves request credentials and network policy, shares the ordinary fetch concurrency/queue budget, consumes progress-only URLSession bytes without staging the complete long-lived body, parses strict Content-Length JPEG parts, decodes through the ordinary codec and working-set gates, and registers with the animation runtime. Finite success, failure, unstarted cancellation, queue rejection, system invalidation, namespace revocation, offscreen/background, critical pressure, Reduce Motion and UIKit/AppKit/SwiftUI replacement are deterministic. No public/default API or physical-device claim follows. Current macOS root tests and Release plus generic iOS Simulator/device Release builds pass.

Six independent process blocks and 48 order-balanced synthetic trials compare the live latest-only single encoded slot with an intentionally decode-every/full-burst baseline. Every accepted trial decodes exactly 2 versus 120 frames, drops 118 superseded frames, retains 1/120 of the baseline encoded queue bytes, and ends at source index 119 with identical final pixels. Paired elapsed ratio median is 0.0404x, p95 0.0924x and maximum 0.1348x. The work is synthetic SHA-256 CPU work, the baseline is not memory-equivalent, and no codec/network/device/product ranking is permitted.

Derived-raster tests no longer infer detached utility-task completion from fixed two-to-eight-second polling windows. The coordinator exposes monotonic scheduled/terminal activity and a cancellation-aware quiescence wait; pipeline tests capture a baseline, prove registration and await the registered cohort. Progressive shared-subscriber tests now validate bufferingNewest(1) coalescing rather than exact all-generation delivery. The 24 affected tests pass under a host where individual 48 MP derived creations required roughly 20-24 seconds. The subsequent smart profile escalated to full premerge and passed formatting, governance, CacheLab, 645 strict root tests, loopback networking, warnings-as-errors Release, PersistentStoreProvider conformance and ImageCodec conformance. This is scheduler-contended correctness and qualification evidence, not a latency target.

W5_PT_110-124 establish a package-only authorized encoded animation transaction. Network and reusable-cache results carry immutable ContentID, namespace generation, fetch-base, exact request-execution and optional selected-representation digests.
